Wellness Origin Spa · Carmel, Indiana

Red light therapy in Carmel

A 30-minute lie-down appointment using a full-body red and near-infrared light blanket. A full-body-plus-face option adds a face mask during the same visit.

Check appointment options

A 30-minute lie-down visit

The source menu describes a full-body red and near-infrared light blanket. The full-body-plus-face option adds a face mask during the same appointment. The published wavelengths are 660 nm and 850 nm; confirm the device with the spa.

What to bring and discuss

The website suggests underwear or a swimsuit and says goggles are provided. Tell the provider about light sensitivity, photosensitizing medications or pregnancy and ask about screening. These prompts are not a complete safety checklist.

Understand the purpose

This is presented as a wellness appointment, not a diagnosis or a treatment plan for a medical condition. Ask the provider about the intended use, limitations and whether it is appropriate for you.
